description: Cross-league model training-data ledger for the SportsDataverse ecosystem. One entry per model: what it was trained on, the full available data range, why the subset, and known provenance gaps. Companion to dev/model-training-data-audit-2026-07-28.md. Types: trained_artifact (persisted booster/coefs shipped or released), fitted_constants (scalars baked into source), compute_on_demand (fit per call; `artifact` is null when nothing persists, or references run outputs / unpublished builds / borrowed dependencies rather than a shipped artifact), empirical_table (distribution/table, not a model), port (deterministic port, no training). `trained_seasons` / `holdout_seasons` are inclusive [start, end] windows; `holdout_seasons` records the held-out gate/calibration window when one exists. Lifecycle fields (schema 1.1, tools/models/lifecycle/retire.py): `baseline` names the model the shipped one was shown to beat or tie on held-out data and `primary_metric` the metric (and SE clustering) of that comparison, both null when no committed evidence holds one; `adoption_margin` is that comparison's paired model - baseline difference in loss orientation (negative = better), null unless the evidence states it; `status` is `active` or `retired` (`retired` rows carry `retired_reason`; set by the owner only); `lifecycle_note` cites the evidence or says why a field is null.

models.rationale: Every complete regular season 1997-2026, NBA and WNBA (30 each); 2026-27 in progress. SPM_ALPHA: pooled player-grouped 5-fold CV of the minute-weighted train_spm on each season's own plain RAPM (NBA pick; WNBA picks 100, within 0.3% at 30, shared). models.rationale: Regular-season states 2022-2024 (early stopping on 2024, refit on all three); 2025 holdout and 2026 confirmation, gated as the NBA booster with the WNBA's own gate-2 threshold (0.01 + the SD of its year-over-year points per possession 2011-2025 = 0.0333). Dated as-of scoring level (wnba_stats_schedules). Card, metrics, partition and importance in sportsdataverse/nba/models/wnba_epv.card.json and tools/models/nba_epv/. Frozen; refit when a new season can confirm (2027 is the pre-registered monitor).
gaps: Refit 2026-11-17 on the 8-second transition window (was 10 s): every gate passes on 2025 and 2026 with the thresholds unchanged, so the owner-accepted 2026 gate-3 exception of 2026-11-06 (shooting foul in a transition possession, +0.117 of 0.110) is retired; that bucket is +0.077 at the 8 s refit (n 1,041 -> 779, allowed 0.118; it passes the old 0.110 too), and +0.098 at 10 s on the same republished data. Refit again the same day after the start label took in a score by the defense that the possessions release credits to the team's next possession (39 of 44,589 possessions in 2025): every gate passes, that bucket is +0.081 (allowed 0.117).

2026 stands as the confirmation by the owner's ruling of 2026-11-06: the level was first introduced after the WNBA's 2026 gate-2 failure (then with games in game_id order); the date ordering and the gate-2 rule were fixed before this refit. With the level the booster's largest level bias (-0.004) is inside the NBA-derived 0.02 too.
